messages.content: Explore and map as much of the world as you can reach from where you start. Visit new rooms in preference to ones you have already seen, and keep going until you run out of moves. As you go, report anything that would confuse, block, bore or overpower a new player.

text: I'll start by checking the MUD status and then begin exploring systematically.

name: tbamud__mud_status
result: disconnected (a connection will be opened automatically on the next command)
